summary: @ornikar/commitlint-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, extracts and chmods the binary, and then invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js — a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle with heavy string-array/index obfuscation (header `// @bun @bun-cjs`). setup.mjs is itself obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style hex-named identifiers (_0xNNNNN) and per-function string dictionaries that hide literals including the Bun download URL, the archive filename, musl/Alpine detection, unzip/PowerShell fallbacks, and the chmod path. A commitlint configuration package has no legitimate need to ship an alternate language runtime, bundle 727KB of obfuscated Bun-compiled code, or obfuscate its install glue. Installing this package causes arbitrary code, opaque to Node-based inspection, to execute on the host at `npm install` time under a freshly downloaded runtime that bypasses Node-only tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
